117808.name: Rabbinical College of Canada T.T.L.
117808.note: CrownHeights.info, 8 Nov 2016: 'Yeshivas Tomchei Tmimim Montreal - established in 1941 - was inviting its students to celebrate its 75th birthday.' (Nine students of the Otwock yeshiva reached Montreal in autumn 1941.) Medium: only one later source so far (Nov 9 audit: the file's rule rates one secondary source medium).

117800.name: Beth Rivkah Academy
117800.note: CrownHeights.info, 31 Oct 2016: 'Beth Rivkah of Montreal ... was established by the Lubavitcher Rebbe sixty years ago (5716 - 1956) with a handful of students.' Rabbi Yosef Minkowitz has been its principal since 1973. Medium: only one later source so far (Nov 9 audit: the file's rule rates one secondary source medium).

118504.name: Jewish Russian Community Center of Montreal
118504.note: CrownHeights.info, 17 May 2012: the centre 'was founded by Rabbi Sirota almost 40 years ago soon after he immigrated to Montreal from the Soviet Union'; 'Rabbi Sirota has been assisting his fellow Russian-speaking Jewish immigrants since he arrived here in 1973 from Tashkent, Uzbekistan, and started a synagogue in his basement.' Medium: 'soon after' his 1973 arrival.

117799.name: Beth Chabad Cote S. Luc
117799.note: CrownHeights.info, 7 Mar 2007: 'The centre was established in a duplex on Earle Road in 1986', later moving to Côte St. Luc Road; led by Rabbi Menachem Mendel and Sarah Raskin. Medium: only one later source so far (Nov 9 audit: the file's rule rates one secondary source medium).

119093.name: Chabad Lifeline
119093.note: CrownHeights.info, 10 Feb 2011: 'It began in 1989 as Project PRIDE, an extension of Fine's work as a McGill University chaplain' (Rabbi Ronnie Fine). Medium: only one later source so far (Nov 9 audit: the file's rule rates one secondary source medium).

117890.name: Montreal Torah Center
117890.note: Its own 'About Us' (read through Firecrawl): 'MTC, headed by Rabbi Moishe and Nechama New and Rabbi Itchy and Zeldie Treitel, began operating in 1991, renting space in an indoor shopping mall'; it expanded its premises three times, and its new centre has been in operation since September 2004.

118505.name: Mada Community Center
118505.note: Mike Cohen's blog (Côte St. Luc councillor), Oct 2006: 'Mada, founded in 1993, also delivers more than 6,000 meals and food baskets every year'. Medium: a blog; Rabbi Chaim Cohen directs it. Low: one weak source (a blog), not confirmed (Nov 9 audit).

118597.name: Chabad of the Town
118597.note: CrownHeights.info, 12 Jan 2017: 'When Rabbi Moshe and Dina Krasnanski opened a small Chabad center there in 2003' (Town of Mount Royal). Medium: only one later source so far (Nov 9 audit: the file's rule rates one secondary source medium).

312417.name: Chabad of Mont Tremblant
312417.note: CrownHeights.info, 30 Jan 2012: Rabbi Yisroel and Liba Mochkin 'have been running Chabad of Mont-Tremblant since its inception six years ago'. Medium: counted back (about 2006); its chabad.org listing went up 14 Sept 2005.

398876.name: La Maison Chabad
398876.note: CrownHeights.info, 27 July 2016: Rabbi Dovid and Devorah Leah Lewin, 'co-directors of the Chabad House (La Maison Chabad Quebec City) since 2006'; 'About the time the Lewins arrived 10 years ago, he came to open the first Chabad House there and serve as community rabbi'. Its chabad.org listing went up 7 July 2006.

398220.name: Jewish Community of Quebec City
398220.note: CrownHeights.info, 27 July 2016: Rabbi Dovid Lewin came about 2006 'to open the first Chabad House there and serve as community rabbi'. Medium: the year Chabad's rabbi came; the Jewish community itself is far older. Its chabad.org listing went up 3 July 2006.

590613.name: Kollel Beth Yossef
590613.note: CrownHeights.info, 14 Aug 2014: the Banons, on staff at the Chai Center, 'even established Kollel Beth Yossef, a daily learning program, in 2006.' Medium: one later source; the listing only went up in Nov 2007 (Nov 9 audit).

1560498.name: Chabad of Lower Laurentians
1560498.note: Canadian Jewish News on CrownHeights.info, 4 June 2013: 'In the two years since Chabad launched a centre in the lower Laurentian town of Saint-Sauveur'; growth 'since 2011' (Rabbi Yitzchok Ezagui). Its chabad.org listing went up 1 July 2011.
